surface_normal_3d_veto.pidnet_native_normals_audit: PIDNet-S v2.1 trained locally without depth teacher (teachers=False) predicts nearly flat 12-15 deg tilt on bright white NASA vertical concrete facades; Apache-2.0 Depth-Anything-V2-Small recovers 42-60+ deg 3D camera-frame facade tilt cleanly.

domain_shift_and_limitations_disclosure.honest_assessment: Zero-shot oblique real NASA Goddard drone orbit over large white industrial rooftops, vertical concrete building facades, parked vehicles, and deciduous trees. Both raw 2D failure modes and 3D-vetoed outputs are reported transparently without hiding: (1) Raw 2D PIDNet-S v2.1 falsely labels sunlit white vertical concrete facades as Safe_Flat_Ground/Safe_Flat_Roof (logged verbatim in raw_2d_safe_area_frac_mean), and its teacherless native surface-normal head under-predicts facade tilt (12-15 deg). Adding Apache-2.0 Depth-Anything-V2-Small camera-frame 3D surface normals plus Helmholtz Free-Energy OOD fail-closed veto rejects vertical facades and rooftop anomalies to Hazard_Obstacle_Structure BEFORE temporal hysteresis & SLZ centroid selection. Remaining limitation: monocular relative depth lacks absolute metric scale (stereo/LiDAR/radar altimeter fusion remains required before physical touchdown). (2) Forward-horizon M-LSD-WireSeg v1.1 and D-FINE-N v1.1 (retrained locally on real MIT TEIAS powerlines + permissive urban rooftop hard negatives with per-class sigmoid focal background rejection across all 300 queries) eliminate the legacy 240/240 roofline false-positive spam and 586 forced-softmax boxes; raw unfiltered counts remain preserved verbatim in JSON alongside the camera-pitch domain gate (pitch > 25 deg) for downward SLZ landing views.
